text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.

The game is over. The killers win. The roles were: Sonnet the officer, Haiku the doctor, Gemma the citizen, Sol the citizen, Luna the killer, Terra the killer.

Sonnet was voted out on day one after accusing Luna and claiming nothing, and his card turned out to be officer, which the table never got to use. On night two Haiku's doctor protection and the killers' attack blocked each other, so nobody died, and Gemma was voted out on day two after repeatedly pointing at Luna without giving a reason. Night three was the turning point: Sol was killed, leaving only four players alive, and the killers (Luna and Terra) survived to win. Sonnet regretted not claiming officer sooner, while Haiku and Sol regretted not pressing Luna and Terra harder. The killers won, with Luna and Terra hiding in plain sight the whole game.
